nowplaying.get.description: Tells you which song is playing on your computer right now, from any music player (or Spotify when you are signed in).
nowplaying.get.returns: found (false when no player is open), title, artist, album, player (its name), artUrl (cover picture link), duration in seconds, link and playing (true/false).

nowplaying.control.description: Presses a media button for your music player, like play, pause or next song. Fails with an error when no music player is open.

parameters.player: Optional. Part of the player's name, like "vlc". Leave it out for the player that is playing now.

nowplaying.control.returns: The name of the player that got the button press.
